displayName: OCI-WSTG04-019: JWT Token Tampering or Forgery
description:
Detects JWT tokens with invalid signatures, expired timestamps, or algorithm manipulation

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg04_019", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%jwt%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%token%') AND "value" > 0
